Emily, Hannah — added operational specifics below and a short runbook excerpt. Full runbook and export playbook will be delivered as a Google Drive package (link below) by EOD Thursday.

Runbook excerpt (high level):
- Week 0 (prep): confirm file manifests, scoping, and a signed evidence access NDA (we can use the existing NDA clause in your MSA).
- Week 1 (export): provide config snapshots (KMS/HSM rotation records, IAM role bindings), and ingestion logs (last 12 months).
- Week 2 (export): provide archival logs and retention mapping; we will include sample queries and a runner script to pull UTC timestamp slices.
- Week 3 (confirm only): DeltaBank to validate exports; Redwood to keep read-only archives available for auditors.
- Week 4 (wrap): deliver attestation summary, remediation tracker, and final sign-off artifact.

Gating items:
- If DeltaBank requires raw key material or private HSM secrets, we cannot comply — we provide rotation proof and KMS config exports only.
- If retention extends beyond 24 months for high-volume logs, we will need a storage addendum; initial estimate is +12% on the renewal ARR for archival storage and export bandwidth. Exact quote depends on token/ingest volume (please provide a 30-day sample if possible).

Capacity pricing placeholder (delta, non-binding):
- +30% reserved throughput (Dedicated pool) — estimated $18k/mo additional (monthly reserved rate), 2-week lead time to provision additional nodes for the Dedicated pool.
- 1-week burst window (on top of reserved): estimated $5k one-time for priority capacity reservation.
